legal_ref: Value Added Tax Act [Cap 247], as amended by Value Added Tax (Amendment) Act No. 42 of 2017
quote: "VAT is an indirect consumption tax imposed at the rate of 15% on most goods and services supplied in Vanuatu by registered persons in the course of a taxable activity."; "...at the rate of 12.5% on the supply of most goods and services. In 2018, this rate was increased to 15%."
source_title: Vanuatu Customs & Inland Revenue – Value Added Tax (VAT) Introduction (vanuatucustoms.gov.vu; customsinlandrevenue.gov.vu did not resolve)
notes: Single 15% rate; zero-rated supplies (0%) and exempt supplies. Compulsory registration when taxable supplies in any 12 months exceed or are expected to exceed VT 4 million. VAT administration is also governed by the Tax Administration Act No. 37 of 2018 (from 1 January 2020).
unverified: Exact commencement 1 January 2018 of Act No. 42 of 2017 seen only in search snippet (PacLII, unreachable); official page says only 'In 2018'
